sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the first bail application filed by applicant under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.118/2023, registered at Police Station-Nayagaon District Satna (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 363/506/376(D)/376/323/366(34)/376(3) of Indian Penal Code and Section 3/6/5/4 of POCSO Act & Section 3(2)(v) of SC & ST (POA) Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 06.05.2023.
Investigation is complete and charge-sheet has been filed.
Prosecutrix is also examined and she is hostile.
In these circumstances, applicant be released on bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the bail application.
